A '''[[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]''' practiced [[Form VII/Legends|Form VII: Juyo / Vaapad]], one of the forms of the [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She wore a robe resembling that of the [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi apparel]] and wielded a blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Ataru" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artists [[Claude Bordeleau]] and [[Angga Satriohadi]]. Since the time period of the game is set around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]-[[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], it is uncertain whether this character may be identified as a proper member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
